title: Dropsical
summary: DROPSICAL, adjective [See Dropsy.] 1. Diseased with dropsy; hydropical; inclined to the dropsy; applied to persons. 2. Partaking of the nature of the dropsy; applied to disease.

inlines.v: DROPSICAL, adjective [See Dropsy.] 1. Diseased with dropsy; hydropical; inclined to the dropsy; applied to persons. 2. Partaking of the nature of the dropsy; applied to disease.
